title: Sunnyfield Zoo
subject: Erste lebende Fremdsprache
text:
WELCOME TO SUNNYFIELD ZOO
Meet our animals and have a happy day!

OPENING HOURS
Open every day: 09:00 - 17:00
Last entry: 16:00

TICKETS
Adult: £12
Child (3-15): £8
Children under 3: free

FEEDING TIMES
Penguins: 11:00
Lions: 13:00
Monkeys: 15:00

Please do not feed the animals. They have their own food.
Visit our gift shop near the exit for toys and postcards.
Please keep the zoo clean. Thank you, and have fun!

annotations.label: What time is the lion feeding?
A family of two adults and one child want tickets. How much do they pay together?
You arrive at the zoo at 15:30. Can you still go in? Why or why not?
annotations.answer: No. The last entry is at 16:00, so 15:30 is fine to go in - yes, you can still go in, because it is before 16:00.

annotations.label: Write a short message to a friend. Tell them when the zoo opens and one feeding time you want to see.
annotations.answer: Modelltext: „Hi! Let's go to Sunnyfield Zoo on Saturday. It opens at 09:00. I want to see the penguins at 11:00. See you there!“ (kurze, korrekte Saetze; eine Uhrzeit aus dem Text).

annotations.label: Work in pairs. Act out buying tickets at the zoo ticket desk.
roles: You are a visitor. Say hello. Ask for one adult ticket and one child ticket. Ask what time the monkey feeding is. Say thank you.
You are the zoo staff at the ticket desk. Greet the visitor. Tell them the prices (use the sign) and the monkey feeding time. Be friendly.
annotations.answer: Erwartet: Besucher:in begruesst, fragt nach Karten („Can I have...?“, „How much is...?“) und nach der Fuetterungszeit; Personal nennt die Preise von der Tafel (Adult: £12, Child: £8) und „15:00“ fuer die Affenfuetterung, reagiert hoeflich.
